mission.title: ollama: Structured output with OpenAI SDK and gpt-oss:20b not working
mission.description: Structured output with OpenAI SDK and gpt-oss:20b not working. This issue affects 56+ users.

steps.title: Identify ollama troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your ollama installation:
```bash
ollama --version
ollama list
```
Look for errors or warnings that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review ollama configuration
steps.description:
Review the relevant ollama configuration:
### What is the issue?

OpenAI SDK is unable to parse structured output from gpt-oss:20b responses. Ollama is supposed to be compatible with OpenAI SDK structured outputs per this [Blog Post](https://ollama.com/blog/structured-outputs).
